listings.name: Club Refrigeration C C
listings.current_description: Club Refrigeration CC is a South African manufacturer specializing in cleanroom design and construction, operating from a facility in Rosslyn, Pretoria. It provides turnkey services from design and engineering to manufacture, installation, repairs and maintenance, covering cleanrooms and GMP facilities, air handling units, fire-rated panels and doors, cannabis processing plants, post-harvest cooling, and mortuaries, serving pharmaceutical, agricultural, and food industry clients.

listings.name: EXAH
listings.current_description: EXAH is a Salesforce and MuleSoft consulting and implementation partner based in Waterkloof, Pretoria, serving clients across Africa, the Middle East and Europe in industries including fintech, healthcare, consumer goods and manufacturing. Founded in 2014, it was named Overall Implementation Partner of the Year for Sub-Saharan Africa by Salesforce for three consecutive years (2021-2023), and was acquired by NTT Data in October 2025.

listings.name: S and P Power Units
listings.current_description: S and P Power Units is a renewable-energy and power-supply company with over 30 years of experience, designing, supplying and installing off-grid and grid-tied solar systems and backup power solutions for commercial, residential and agricultural clients. The business also offers battery repacking for cordless appliances and power tools, and stocks solar panels, inverters and batteries from brands including Victron, Varta and Trina Solar.

listings.name: RATHUSA Glass And Aluminium
listings.current_description: Rathusa Glass & Aluminium has worked in the glass and aluminium industry for 14 years and is a member of the South African Glazing and Glaziers Association (SAGGA), adhering to the industry's code of conduct. It supplies and installs windows and doors including uPVC, steel, wooden and aluminium windows, double glazed and sliding or folding doors, and has done extensive glazing work on RDP and GAP housing projects as well as for government institutions.

listings.name: Woodhill Country Club
listings.current_description: Woodhill Country Club is an 18-hole, par-72 golf course and clubhouse in Woodhill Golf Estate, built on a former dairy farm and opened in 1999. The parkland layout plays over undulating, tree-lined fairways with a mix of kikuyu and bent grass, and the course hosted the South African PGA Championship in 2001. On-site facilities include a driving range, pro shop, teaching academy, locker rooms, and a clubhouse restaurant and bar with panoramic terraces overlooking the course.
